label: The sleep archive
title: The city has stopped dreaming.
author: Mara Venn
deck: Every night, the city records its sleeping citizens. Then, without explanation, the tapes go silent. An essay on memory, consent, and the people who keep the machines running.

label: Borrowed daylight
title: Who owns the morning?
author: Ilan Sato
deck: An orbital mirror delivers seven unbilled minutes of daylight to a forgotten square. What begins as a calibration error becomes an argument about the things a city owes its people.
